observations.summary: ADNOC Logistics & Services publicly confirmed that one of its vessels was attacked while transiting the Strait of Hormuz on the evening of November 17. Eleven crew were injured and one remains missing; others evacuated. ADNOC did not attribute the attack or identify the vessel. Source announcement time is not established; this is a newly verified corporate account of an earlier event, not proof of a new attack after the prior scan.
observations.title: ADNOC confirms November 17 Hormuz vessel attack with injured and missing crew
